title: No cookie, no session — 401 from the cookie-auth middleware
description: Any protected endpoint called without the access_token cookie is rejected by middleware before the handler runs. This is the negative assertion every conformance run should make first.
notes: Verified against the delivered gateway middleware (internal/http/middleware/auth.go): a missing cookie yields exactly {"error": "missing access_token cookie"} and a present-but-invalid one yields {"error": "invalid token"}. Assert on the 401, never on the string — the /api/v1 error model carries no machine-readable code.
